mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS "id", r.barcode AS "barcode", r.receive_date AS "receiveDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = r.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", r.qty AS "qty", r.unit_price AS "unitPrice", COALESCE((SELECT ci.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item ci JOIN tb_common_code_group cg ON cg.common_code_group_id = ci.group_id AND cg.group_code = 'TAX_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant ct ON ct.tenant_id = cg.tenant_id AND ct.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE ci.item_code = r.tax_type LIMIT 1), r.tax_type) AS "taxType", COALESCE(r.is_return, 0) AS "isReturn", r.return_reason AS "returnReason", r.return_of_id AS "returnOfId", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(r2.qty)), 0) FROM material_receiving r2 WHERE r2.return_of_id = r.id AND r2.receive_date <= #{date}) AS "returnedQty" FROM material_receiving r WHERE r.material_code = #{code} AND r.receive_date <= #{date} AND COALESCE(r.is_return, 0) = 0 ORDER BY r.receive_date DESC, r.id DESC
